about: Which model the setup page and the chat's Settings suggest after 'List models' at a hosted provider.
Each entry is a name to look for, best first. Spelling is loose: case, spaces, dashes, dots and
slashes are ignored, so 'glm 5.3' finds 'zai-org/GLM-5.3'. The first entry that the provider
actually lists is suggested; if several of its models match, the shortest name wins.
'providers' is keyed by the provider's name in model-servers.json. A provider's own entries are
tried first, then 'default'. A provider without entries uses 'default' alone.
Suggest only models that call tools well: Cedar acts through tool calls.
'reasoning' fills the reasoning-levels dropdown of the chat's Settings: 'presets' are the sets it
offers, and 'models' says which levels a model takes ('match' is loose in the same way; the first
entry that a model's name contains wins). A model no entry matches starts without reasoning levels.
'images' says which models read images, for a model saved without being told ('match' is loose in
the same way; the first entry that a model's name contains wins, so put the narrower name first).
A model no entry matches is tried with a small image when it is saved.
